comment: She is so insanely smart. Extremely knowledgeable in her field and is a great teacher and is funny. Have taken other classes with her and both are very reading heavy so be ready to read a lot. But I learned A LOT in both classes. She makes class interesting and teaches interesting topics. Very helpful outside of class and gives good feedback.

Dr. Roof is brilliant and seems to know quite literally anything you could ask her. She expects a lot from her students, but if you put in the time, you will learn more than you ever have in 4 months. I highly recommend taking her course, though perhaps alongside a lighter schedule. Approachable outside class, lecture heavy, long written exams.

This class felt quite boring to me because the instructor talked the entire time, and there was very little class participation. It wasn't very engaging, and it was hard to stay focused. Additionally, the grading was extremely tough—as if we were expected to be experts on the topic already.

Sweetest most brilliant woman ever. She is super passionate about her field and it shows in the classroom. She is very lecture and reading-heavy; however, that is kind of par for the course for a political science class. Definitely take her if you are majoring in political science, you will learn so much from her.
Dr. Roof is an amazing professor. Learned a lot from the class.

Another great semester w/Roof. Much easier course this time I feel and still the same great lecturer and person from last semester. 5 short reading response papers, 3 exams (one open-note and online), and participation/group work make up the grade. She is a fantastic prof and really hope to have her again in the future. Highly recommend to all.

I got a lot out of this class because Dr. Roof is so knowledgeable about the subject and tons of detail is covered. She is very helpful in office hours. It was overall very interesting and I'm glad I took it. But she grades papers harshly and studying for the exams takes forever. It's also completely lecture based with basically no participation.

Great professor with so much knowledge about the field. Readings aren't technically mandatory as most classes are lecture-heavy but are very necessary for the midterm and final exams. She expects a lot for an introductory class but you will learn so much which is great if you are interested in politics.

Great professor who is incredibly gifted at her job. An excellent professor to have for a political science course. Friendly and approachable. Fairly difficult class and lecture heavy. Lots of reading assigned. Helped spark my love for political science, intending to major in it. Highly recommend her to anyone.

Professor Roof is an amazing professor.  She is not particularly easy, but if you pay attention in class you will be set.  Readings are important but I would not say necessary to understand the material. Tests are somewhat hard but if you do the readings and pay attention to her lectures you will be fine.  Highly recommend to any PPEL/PLSC major.

Dr. Roof is very knowledgeable, and the class is extremely lecture-based. There are a lot of readings that you don't need for class the next day but will need for the midterm and final. Besides the readings, workload is very manageable in terms of papers. If you've taken APUSH, AP US Gov, and AP Comp Gov, you'll probably be bored but it'll be easy.

Dr Roof is a great professor but goes into EXCRUCIATING detail for an intro class, especially with healthcare. The papers were difficult but she gives good advice if you go to office hours. The tests have very detailed study guides with exact questions that are on the test. Not an easy class but if you put in the work you can do well.

Dr. Roof is very knowledgeable about the field and is a good teacher. The class is definitely challenging with a lot of reading but manageable if you put in a reasonable effort. Papers and exams aren't too bad and I learned a lot in the course. Helpful to have background knowledge of US govt + policy.

Dr. Roof is a true queen at UR. Her lectures were so energetic and unbiased, creating a room for students to form their own opinions and share them. The readings were long, but a skim was fine. She is one of the most knowledge women you will meet in the field of Political Science and my only complaint is that she doesn't teach more classes at UR.

Loved how informative and passionate Dr. Roof is about her subject. Lots of reading which you don't really need for class, but will for the exams. Essays aren't graded too hard but grades aren't put in for weeks, so it's hard to know what kind of grade you are looking at until the end of the semester. Learned a lot.

Dr. Roof is incredibly smart and she is a great person. She definitely has a style when it comes to grading papers so once I met with her and figured out what I was looking for the class was a breeze. Midterm and a final, both easy. She mainly reads off powerpoints and it can get boring, but she's always willing to answer questions.

She is clear on what she expects. She goes through power points every class which can get pretty boring, but the midterm and final are straight off the study guide and the papers and debates are clear.

Dr. Roof is a brilliant professor. She is very knowledgeable in her field, which I appreciated as a poli sci major. Class consists of taking notes during lecture, not much else. If you're into the subject, it won't be bad. Readings are frequent but manageable. She is a tough grader on papers, but an A is not out of reach. She's really funny, too!

I took Dr. Roof's intro to public policy class. It's a difficult class with a lot of reading and great expectations on papers. That being said, Dr. Roof is a really engaging teacher who is always willing to meet with you and help you out and go over essay outlines. Her class has made me a better student. Great prof, hope to have her again.

She is sooo nice. And very knowledgeable.  But if you don't know anything about polisci or public policy before taking her fys, and you dont plan to go into those subjects, you will feel overwhelmed like I did. Class is boring. But I did learn alot. She's probably a great professor if you are into public policy or political science.

Very intelligent and nice person.  I felt like I learned a lot from this first year seminar.  Most of the information was also very interesting.  However, some of the content is difficult to understand and can hurt you when writing essays, so not the easiest class.  She is a tough grader, but also a fair grader.

While her class is not the most interesting, I definitely feel like I learned a lot. She lectures with a PowerPoint pretty much every class but does allow for some discussion. She's a reasonably fair grader but don't expect an easy A. She assigns a lot of reading and there are multiple essays, but the workload is definitely doable. She's very nice and funny in class and cuts students a break if you miss a reading or need an extension.

shes super nice, and brilliant and so knowledgable about complex, int'l issues; however, dont recommend for FYS. the concepts are too large (healthcare across tons of countries, pensions, welfare, etc - should've been 1), WAY too much reading/night, no discussions, lectures whole time, so u dont do readings then screwed for her hard papers, picky

Roof's style was overwhelming for me. On the first day, she said this class would be discussion based, but very few students talked in my section. Most classes were lectures with powerpoint with way to much information. I spent the entire class frantically trying to write down what she was saying, but it was just too much information to grasp.

Dr. Roof was really nice but had trouble keeping the class discussions going. I learned more in that class about real life than in any other I've taken so far. She is a tough grader and expects a lot out of you on papers but the topics are interesting!
Hard because there is a tremendous amount of reading-looks at both sides of issues. 2 papers and 2 exams- focused and pertinent. Responds promptly to emails.  Excellent prof-worthwhile class.

was not interesting didnt know how to guide discussions.  Study guide is the exam.  She has no idea how to write an exam so literally word vomit it and you will be good.  If you can take someone else but not to bad if you are stuck with her.

I really liked her class. Lots of reading, but a lot of people didn't bother. It doesn't really matter if you do or not. The papers aren't based on topics that would require it. The tests aren't bad. Make sure to study the study guides. They're basically the tests. She kept it interesting and was great at helping outside of class. Would recommend

I love Roof...that's pretty much it. Intro American Gov't can be pretty boring since it's pretty much a rehash of high school, but Roof always made class interesting, plus she has a pretty good sense of humor. She doesn't grade easily but she's always willing to help...
Wonderful and helpful.  Most educated in the poli-sci department.  Would take any class that she taught!

had her before she had her PhD - she led some interesting discussions and was very open to having all views represented.  her grading expectations were not clear and some of her exam questions were on really minute topics hardly discussed
she likes to make comments on work. dont expect much if you do papers the night before.
smoking hot... but not very bright
She was miserable, I hated going to class, she was only interested in advancing her carreer, she was boring. Pretty much hated that class.

2 different professors with Roof: 1 is great in class, leads amazing discussions, funny.  Then she breaks out the red pen for papers and tests and you are left completely mystified.  How can someone so cool in class be so hard a grader?  If she's reading this: yes you are a very tough grader!
No Comments
nice lady but tough grader. you better be into the subject. on a side note, she does not seem to mind missed classes

Roof is a good teacher.  She is friendly, committed to students, and her class is interesting.  Still, her grading is tough.  Go in there for love of politics, cause you will not help your gpa with her.
Dr. Roof is probably the best professor at UR.  Her class isn't easy, but it won't kill you.  She always keeps it interesting.
No Comments
